subHeadings.list: Let your smart home act on its own
subHeadings.add: Name it now, draw its flow afterwards
subHeadings.flow: Place blocks on the canvas and connect them

ok.title: OK
ok.description: The automation is in order and runs when it is enabled.

invalid.title: Invalid
invalid.description: The automation cannot run: one of its blocks is not configured correctly or refers to something that no longer exists.

suspended.title: Suspended
suspended.description: The automation was stopped because it was running too often. Check its flow, then enable it again.

single.title: Single
single.description: While the automation is running, new triggers are ignored.

restart.title: Restart
restart.description: A new trigger stops the running automation and starts it again.

parallel.title: Parallel
parallel.description: Every trigger starts its own run, next to the ones already running.

texts.noAutomations: You don't have any automation yet
texts.loadFailed: The automations could not be loaded.
texts.confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Are you sure you want to discard them?
texts.confirmRemove: Are you sure you want to remove the automation "{automation}"?
texts.addHint: A new automation is created disabled and with an empty flow. It can be enabled once its flow has at least one trigger.

description.title: Description
description.placeholder: Optional description of what the automation does

space.title: Space
space.hint: Only used to find the automation in lists. It does not limit what the automation may control.

messages.requestError: Something went wrong while loading the automation.
messages.loadFailed: The automation could not be loaded.
messages.notEnabledIncomplete: Automation "{automation}" cannot be enabled: its flow is not complete. It needs at least one trigger and every block configured.
messages.changedElsewhere: Automation "{automation}" was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Your changes were kept: review them and save again to apply them.

changed.name: Device value changes
changed.description: Starts the automation when a value of a device changes.

compare.name: Device value is
compare.description: Continues on "yes" when a value of a device meets the comparison, otherwise on "no".

set.name: Set device value
set.description: Sets one or more values of devices.

start.name: Manual start
start.description: Starts the automation when somebody runs it by hand.

of-day.name: Time of day
of-day.description: Starts the automation at a time of day.

window.name: Time is between
window.description: Continues on "yes" when the time is inside the window, otherwise on "no".

delay.name: Delay
delay.description: Waits for a while before the flow continues.

texts.confirmDiscardDraft: The text in the form of this block is not valid JSON, so it has not been applied. Do you want to discard it?
texts.unknownNodeType: This block is no longer available
texts.unknownNodeTypeHint: The block type "{type}" is not offered any more, most likely because the plugin that provided it was removed or disabled. Remove the block, or bring the plugin back.
texts.separateFlows: This automation holds several flows that are not connected to each other. In the Restart mode a trigger of one flow also stops the others, so unrelated flows belong to separate automations.

form.nothingToConfigure: This block has nothing to configure.

rejections.unknown_port: These two points cannot be connected.
rejections.into_trigger: A trigger starts the automation, so nothing can lead into it.
rejections.self: A block cannot be connected to itself.
rejections.duplicate: These two points are connected already.
rejections.cycle: This connection would make the flow loop back on itself.
rejections.limit: The flow cannot hold any more blocks or connections.

issues.unknown_node_type: This block is no longer available.
issues.unknown_port: A connection uses a point this block does not have.
issues.edge_into_trigger: A trigger starts the automation, so nothing can lead into it.
issues.cycle: The flow loops back on itself.
issues.duplicate_edge: Two connections join the same two points.
issues.no_trigger: The automation needs at least one trigger to start it.
issues.unreachable_node: No trigger leads to this block, so it never runs.
issues.self_triggering_write: This action sets a value that a trigger of the same automation watches, so every run can start the automation again. If that is not meant, set another value or watch another one.

conflict.title: The automation was changed elsewhere
conflict.description: This automation was saved somewhere else while you were editing it. Nothing you have drawn is lost. Choose which version to keep.
conflict.confirmReload: Your unsaved changes to the flow will be discarded. Do you want to continue?

messages.conflict: Automation "{automation}" was changed elsewhere in the meantime. Your changes are kept; choose which version to keep.
messages.invalid: The flow of automation "{automation}" cannot be saved yet. Check the problems listed below the canvas.
messages.invalidDraft: Some text in the form of the selected block is not valid JSON. Correct it or undo it before saving.
messages.busy: The automation is still being read or saved. Try again once that is done.
messages.unsafe: The flow of automation "{automation}" cannot be saved: an action would unlock, disarm or open something, which an automation is not allowed to do.

safety.notOffered: An automation acts without anybody present, so it may lock, arm and close, but not unlock, disarm or open. Choose another value.

kinds.unlock: This value would unlock a lock
kinds.disarm: This value would disarm the alarm
kinds.open: This value would open a door, garage or gate

modes.fromTo: changes from one value to another

hysteresis.title: Hysteresis
hysteresis.hint: How far the value has to come back before crossing the threshold starts the automation again. Leave empty for none.

for.title: Only once it has stayed like this for
for.hint: The value has to stay in the new state the whole time; leaving it, or the device going offline, starts the wait again.

operators.gte: is greater than or equal to
operators.lte: is less than or equal to

values.title: Values
values.placeholder: Type a value and press Enter

time.houseClock: On the 24-hour clock of the house timezone.

window.hint: The window is on the house clock.
window.overnight: The window crosses midnight; the days are the days it starts on.

manual.hint: The automation starts here when somebody runs it by hand from the list of automations.

scene.title: Scene
scene.hint: Every time it runs, the scene is checked again: a scene that would unlock, disarm or open something is not run.

delay.title: Wait for
delay.hint: At most one hour. A delay does not survive a restart of the server.

validation.unknownField: This field is not known to the block.
validation.value: The value must be a text, a number or yes/no.
validation.hysteresis: The hysteresis must be a number that is not negative.
validation.duration: The duration must be a whole number of seconds.
validation.durationMin: The duration must be at least 1 second.
validation.forMax: The duration can be at most 7 days.
validation.delayMax: A delay can be at most 1 hour.
validation.thresholdAndValue: A threshold cannot be combined with a value to change to or from.
validation.forNeedsState: Waiting needs a state to hold: a value it becomes, or a threshold. It cannot be used with "from".
validation.values: The values must be a list.
validation.valuesEmpty: At least one value is needed.
validation.notUsedByOperator: This comparison does not use this value.
validation.maxBelowMin: The upper end must not be below the lower end.
validation.writes: The values to set must be a list.
validation.writesEmpty: At least one value to set is needed.
validation.writesMax: At most 20 values can be set by one action.
validation.propertyTwice: The same property is set twice by this action.
validation.time: The time must be written as HH:mm.
validation.weekday: A day must be one of the days of the week.
validation.weekdays: The days must be a list.
validation.weekdaysEmpty: At least one day is needed.
validation.weekdaysTwice: A day can be picked only once.
validation.windowEmpty: The end must differ from the start.
validation.severity: Choose how urgent the notification is.
validation.title: A title is needed.
validation.titleMax: The title can be at most 120 characters long.
validation.message: The message must be a text.
validation.messageMax: The message can be at most 1000 characters long.
